datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a monthly schedule (January, April, July, October 2015) across Malawi administrative units. The data represents near-term projections of acute food insecurity phases under different scenarios, spatially encoded as geographic features with classification scales and assistance requirements.
